---
title: "visual_psycho"
output: html_document
---
Load tidyverse
```{R}
library(tidyverse)
```
Create sample data with 1 A and 99 B
```{R}
df <- data.frame(x = runif(100), y = runif(100), cl = sample(c(rep("A", 1), rep("B", 99))))

df %>% filter(cl == "A")
df %>% filter(cl != "A")
```

Plot 1
```{R}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x, y, shape = cl)) + theme_bw() + geom_point() + theme(legend.position = "None", aspect.ratio = 1)

```

Plot 2
```{R}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x, y, colour = cl)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "None", aspect.ratio = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

Generate data from tb
```{R}
tb <- read_rds("data/tb_tidy.rds")
tb

# data pre-processing
tb_au <- filter(tb, country == "Australia") %>%
  rename(age = age_group) %>% 
  filter(!(age %in% c("04", "014", "514", "u"))) %>%
  filter(year > 1996, year < 2013)

tb_au
```

Plot 1: answer the question “Is the incidence similar for males and females in 2012 across age groups?”
```{R}
tb_au %>% filter(year == 2012) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = count, fill = sex)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + facet_grid( ~ age ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
```

Plot 2: answer the question “Is the incidence similar for age groups in 2012, across sex?”
```{R}
tb_au %>% filter(year == 2012) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = count, fill = age)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + facet_grid( ~ sex ) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
```
